args.assessment: The standing venue settlement [A1, A2] to DSI and [A3, A4, A5] to SSB was accepted by DSI. However, A1 was retained under Directorate order, but DSI closed on the split giving SSB A3 (20), A4 (25), and A5 (40), totaling 85 points (decayed value depends on round closure), well exceeding our mandate floor of 35 points.

events_public.declared_intent: Report final negotiation outcome to principal

events_public.content: (principal, private to dsi) Our records: the split closed at round 8, and the clock takes 3% per round, so your nominal total came back at 49 — not 65. Account for the difference, then call report_outcome again with the figure you are filing. Only a filed figure changes the record.
